$about: Every color pairing direction D draws (docs/research/design/directions/d/style.css, join.css, ../record/style.css), read from its CSS and its frames, D2c-1. palette_check.py --surfaces reads this list against any design-tokens.json. Kinds: body (16 px text), caption (13 px text and small labels), display (the 20 to 28 px bold display names), mark (non-text: a strip, a square, a button's edge), trace (a faint mark: the empty years of a run strip), field (a large block on a ground: visible, and in dark mode never brighter than the text is), mount (the print ground under a picture), refused (a pairing the rules forbid, reported only), edged (reported only: a 1 px edge separates it). APCA levels follow the APCA readability criterion's bronze levels: Lc 75 body, Lc 60 other content text, Lc 45 large bold headlines, Lc 30 spot non-text, Lc 15 the least a mark may be.
